definitions.explanation: The length of time a person or organism lives, or the expected duration of life.
The expected duration of functionality for machines, products, or other non-living things before they wear out or need replacement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{寿命|じゅみょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: The average lifespan of Japanese people is long.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{寿命|じゅみょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{延|の}びた→延びる：19599_nobiru⟧。
examples.english: Lifespans have increased due to advances in medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧{寿命|じゅみょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{延|の}ばす→延ばす：28291_nobasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It is important to extend healthy life expectancy.

examples.japanese: ⟦バッテリー→バッテリー：04425_batterii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寿命|じゅみょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}い→短い：00510_mijikai⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寿命|じゅみょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧{十年|じゅうねん}だ。
examples.english: The service life of this product is about ten years.

examples.japanese: ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寿命|じゅみょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}た→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{買|か}い{替|か}えた→買い替える：19456_kaikaeru⟧。
examples.english: The air conditioner reached the end of its life, so I replaced it.

notes:
USAGE:
{寿命|じゅみょう} is used for both living things and products/machines. When used for products, it functions similarly to English "lifespan" or "service life."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{寿命|じゅみょう} — average lifespan
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧{寿命|じゅみょう} — healthy life expectancy
- {寿命|じゅみょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{延|の}びる→延びる：19599_nobiru⟧ — lifespan increases
- {寿命|じゅみょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{縮|ちぢ}む→縮む：00027_chijimu⟧ — lifespan shortens
- {寿命|じゅみょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ — to reach end of life

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has one of the highest average lifespans in the world. The concept of ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧{寿命|じゅみょう} (healthy life expectancy) — years lived in good health, as opposed to total lifespan — has become an important topic in public health discussions.
